# Moss troll, the boss: a hulking lilac-grey body with slate armour plates, a mossy hump, short legs and a
# wooden club. 1.05 x 0.75 x 1.3 m. make_env.py.
new
material new Skin --base-color 0.6471 0.5765 0.6471 --no-slot
material new Plate --base-color 0.4353 0.4039 0.4627 --no-slot
material new Moss --base-color 0.3333 0.4392 0.3922 --no-slot
material new Club --base-color 0.5529 0.3843 0.4078 --no-slot
material new Eye --base-color 0.7725 0.8000 0.7216 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name LegL --size 1 --location -0.2000 0.0000 0.2200
scale 0.2200 0.2600 0.4400
apply --scale
material assign Plate
add mesh cube --name LegR --size 1 --location 0.2000 0.0000 0.2200
scale 0.2200 0.2600 0.4400
apply --scale
material assign Plate
add mesh cube --name Torso --size 1 --location 0.0000 0.0000 0.7200
scale 0.7200 0.5000 0.6000
apply --scale
material assign Skin
add mesh ico-sphere --name Hump --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.3600 --location 0 0 0
set rotation 0.0 0.0 0.0
apply --rotation
scale 1.100 0.800 0.700
apply --scale
translate 0.0000 0.1800 1.0000
material assign Moss
add mesh cube --name Head --size 1 --location 0.0000 -0.3000 1.0000
scale 0.3600 0.3000 0.2800
apply --scale
material assign Skin
add mesh cube --name Brow --size 1 --location 0.0000 -0.4600 1.0800
scale 0.3800 0.0600 0.0800
apply --scale
material assign Plate
add mesh cube --name Eyes --size 1 --location 0.0000 -0.4700 0.9800
scale 0.2400 0.0400 0.0600
apply --scale
material assign Eye
add mesh cube --name ArmL --size 1 --location -0.4600 -0.0600 0.6600
scale 0.1800 0.2000 0.5000
apply --scale
material assign Skin
add mesh cube --name ArmR --size 1 --location 0.4600 -0.0600 0.6600
scale 0.1800 0.2000 0.5000
apply --scale
material assign Skin
add mesh cube --name Belt --size 1 --location 0.0000 0.0000 0.4800
scale 0.7600 0.5400 0.1000
apply --scale
material assign Plate
add mesh cone --name Club --vertices 6 --radius1 0.1 --radius2 0.16 --depth 0.7 --location 0 0 0
set rotation 70 0 0
apply --rotation
translate 0.5 -0.3 0.42
material assign Club
select all
shade flat
export troll.glb
